comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district sign data. Passing into a community triggers an in-world sign and HUD callout. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon, projected at runtime. needs_owner_review:true means the owner's lived knowledge should confirm placement — the owner is authoritative over map data.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow peninsula and its iconic strip road from Norman Manley Airport to Kingston

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout junction at the end of the Palisadoes strip — gateway into Kingston

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Eastern Kingston hillside community near Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Eastern Kingston community along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern business and hotel district

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: St. Andrew's main hub — shops, transport, and the famous 1813 clock tower

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's ancient colonial capital in St. Catherine (route passes on bypass)

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Community at the mouth of the Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge just ahead

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town immortalised in the folk song — ackee and saltfish country

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Town in St. Catherine near the alumina plant

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hilltop village at a historic road junction — cool mountain air and coconut water stops

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Cruise port and beach town on Jamaica's north coast — journey's end
